title: Your ticket screenshot can expire
learningObjective: Explain time-limited rotating barcodes and why an old screenshot can be rejected while the underlying ticket remains valid; distinguish static tickets and issuer rules.

segments.text: Tech Under the Hood, episode one. Your ticket screenshot can expire.
Your ticket is still valid. But this pass uses a rotating barcode.
You take a screenshot. Both images contain the same code.
Time moves on. The live pass displays a new code. Your screenshot stays frozen.
At the gate, the reader checks the code against its allowed time window. That old copy can fail.
Open the live pass. Its current code can pass that time check.
This makes old screenshots harder to reuse. The reader checks the code, not whether the image is a screenshot.
Some tickets use static codes instead. Follow your issuer’s instructions.
For a rotating ticket, open the live pass before you queue. A saved picture cannot refresh itself.
